item.title: Shuukatsu Katei Kyoushi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Monomanie
  • 発売日: 2015-03-13
  • スコア: 5.75/10 (17 人評価)
  • 日本語名: シュウカツ家庭教師
  • 英語名: Shuukatsu Katei Kyoushi

あらすじ

The story is about a college student named Sata Akiko who becomes a tutor for a boy recommended by her professor. If she does well, her professor will help her find a job. However, the boy tries to stop her from teaching by being mean and eventually sexually harassing her. He even threatens to tell his mother if she refuses. Akiko feels like she can’t fail the job and becomes submissive to the boy’s whims, leading her into a world of shame and pleasure.

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Monomanie
  • 発売日: 2014-10-03
  • スコア: 6.959999999999999/10 (20 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 金髪太郎物語
  • 英語名: Kinpatsu Tarou Monogatari

あらすじ

The story is about a blonde hair blue-eyed boy named Tarou who grew up receiving his mother’s love in a nature-filled area called Ashukurayama. Recently, Tarou has been feeling a warm sensation in his lower abdomen when he takes baths with his mother or wrestles with his beast female friends. He consults with the elder of the mountain, Tamamo, who tells him that it’s natural for boys to be attracted to girls’ feminine energy. That night, when Tarou takes a bath with his mother, he gets aroused and his mother takes it upon herself to guide him through his first sexual experience. The next morning, Tarou finds himself in a world that has transformed from innocent picture books to adult erotica.
